verdict.rationale: Brex's own docs describe the core loop of this story. Finance can assign top-line budgets (brex-docs-10) and manage Budgets and Spend Limits via the UI and API (brex-docs-5), including for entities and departments (brex-docs-45). Limits are described as auto-enforced, with out-of-policy purchases blocked (brex-docs-9, brex-docs-36), and approval routing is policy-driven and multi-level (brex-docs-8, brex-docs-11). Missing for 10: explicit project-level budget allocation, documentation that a budget directly governs card limits and approvals, and independent or hands-on confirmation that enforcement works as claimed.
